question: Should OpenClaw adopt this cross-cutting core plugin API, persisted safety-history store, Gateway methods, and Control UI as one supported product contract, or should the work be narrowed to an approved core event seam with optional consumers kept in plugins?
rationale: The branch changes public plugin, persistence, observability, and operator UX boundaries together; code review cannot choose their permanent ownership and compatibility commitments.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed core contract
options.body: Approve a small documented core event contract and ownership model first, then land only required emitters and separately stage optional exporter and UI consumers.

options.title: Adopt the full platform
options.body: Explicitly accept the plugin API, manifest capability, durable storage, Gateway methods, and Control UI as stable supported surfaces with upgrade commitments.

options.title: Keep optional consumers out of core
options.body: Retain only an approved generic seam and move exporter-specific, dashboard, and third-party integration behavior to plugins.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed core contract
recommendation.body: Approve a small documented core event contract and ownership model first, then land only required emitters and separately stage optional exporter and UI consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the evidence-backed author of the full proposal and can respond to the requested narrowing; final product sponsorship remains a maintainer decision.
